# War Scroll Column 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**7:1** And no boy or woman shall enter into-their-camps when-they-go-forth from Jerusalem to-go to-battle, until they-return.

**7:2** And no-one lame or blind or crippled, or a man who-has a permanent-blemish in-his-flesh, or a man smitten with an-impurity-of his-flesh —

**7:3** none of-these shall-go-forth with-them to-battle. All-of-them shall-be men-of-the-volunteers-for-war, perfect in-spirit and-in-body, and prepared for-the-day-of-vengeance.

**7:4** And any man who-is-not pure with-respect-to his-sexual-emission on-the-day-of-battle shall-not go-down with-them into-battle, for the holy-angels are-together with-their-battle-lines.

**7:5** And there-shall-be a distance between all-their-camps and the place-of-the-hand [latrine], about two-thousand cubits, and no-unseemly nakedness shall-be-seen in-the-surroundings-of all-their-camps.

**7:6** And when-they-set-out for-battle they-shall-arrange in-their-encampments, and they-shall-take-their-positions each-man in-his-place, and they-shall-keep-watch with-their-weapons in-their-hands.

**7:7** And armed-escorts shall-go-out for-the-need-of the-camp, and they-shall-stand guard continually over-all the arrangements-of the-camp, and they-shall-not profane the holy-things-of their-encampments.

**7:8** And the sentries shall-stand upon-their-posts around the camps, and the watchmen in-the-watches-of the-night, and they-shall-not put-down their-weapons.

**7:9** And any-man who-needs to-go outside for-a-bodily-need shall-go with-his-weapons, and the armed-escort shall-be around-him until he-returns to-the-camp.

**7:10** And when-the-battle-lines are-drawn-up, there-shall-be three rows-of-horsemen on-this-side and three rows-of-horsemen on-that-side.

**7:11** And between the rows a distance-of one-hundred cubits, and between rank-and-rank fifty cubits, and they-shall-stand in-their-order before the battle-formation.

**7:12** And each-row shall-have one-hundred horsemen, and they-shall-be arranged on-the-flanks-of the-formation, seven-hundred on-the-one-side and seven-hundred on-the-other.

**7:13** And they-shall-spread-outward to-the-right and-to-the-left-of the-line-of-battle, to-frighten the enemy-of-God, and to-cut-off those-who-flee.

**7:14** And the men-of-the-battle-line shall-be from forty years to fifty years, and the camp-marshals shall-be from fifty to sixty years.

**7:15** And the horsemen shall-be from thirty years to forty-five years, and those-who-strip the-slain and those-who-collect the-plunder and those-who-cleanse the-land —

**7:16** these shall-be from twenty-five to thirty years. And no youth shall-go-out with-them on-the-day-of-battle.

**7:17** And all-these shall-be volunteers-for-the-war-of-God, men-of-understanding and men-of-strength, and they-shall-serve according-to the-ordering-of-their-divisions.

---

*EMET notes: Column 7 is well preserved. "Place-of-the-hand" (yad) is the Hebrew euphemism for latrine; glossed in brackets. Purity requirements echo Deuteronomy 23:10-15 applied to eschatological warfare. The phrase "holy angels are together with their battle-lines" (7:4) provides the theological rationale for the extreme purity rules.*
